name: Amenta
source:
Amenta follows Seth, a young Egyptian god, who had often dreamed of becoming a loved and respected King to Ancient Egypt.
Unfortunately, his fellow gods think otherwise of him.

[From [url=https://cervineprince.itch.io/amenta-vn]itch.io[/url]]
